name: Little Red Ranger
source:
Innocent folks have been disappearing in the, otherwise, quiet town of Meadowvale. Clover the Park Ranger is tasked with solving the disappearances of their fellow townsfolk and friends. However, the truth may be closer than they were expecting...

You'll take on the role as Sable Wood's Ranger and investigate the situation at paw, questioning the latest witness and exploring the scene of the crime.

Beware, however; your actions can have severe consequences.

[From [url=https://daisy-san.itch.io/little-red-ranger]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在原本安静的梅多维尔小镇，无辜者不断失踪。公园管理员克洛弗的任务是解决镇民和朋友失踪的问题。然而，事实或许比他们想象的更接近……

你将扮演塞布尔·伍德的游侠，调查爪子的情况，询问最新的证人并探索犯罪现场。

但要小心；你的行为可能会产生严重的后果。

[来自[url=https://daisy-san.itch.io/little-red-ranger]itch.io[/url]]
